# Value Tracking Skill

Ensure every major feature can prove measurable customer impact.

## When to Use This Skill

- User asks how to measure feature success
- Need KPI definitions for new portal modules
- Need instrumentation/event schema guidance

## KPI Framework

- Adoption: DAU/WAU, active teams, repeat usage
- Effectiveness: completion rates, task success, error rates
- Business impact: cycle time, deflection, quality, time saved
- Cost: forecast vs actual platform usage/licensing

## Workflow

1. Identify primary outcome for the feature.
2. Define leading + lagging KPIs.
3. Establish baseline and target.
4. Define required telemetry events.
5. Create dashboard/reporting cadence.

## Output Template

- Feature
- Outcome hypothesis
- KPIs (definition + formula)
- Baseline/target
- Telemetry events
- Reporting cadence
- Risks to measurement quality
